subject: Data Engineering
title: What Is OLAP?
description: A quick, practical guide to What Is OLAP?.

hook.text: Show me total sales by region, product, and quarter. That's not a transaction — that's OLAP.

buildup.text: OLAP stands for Online Analytical Processing — complex queries that scan millions of rows.

discovery.text: OLAP systems use columnar storage and parallel processing to crunch large datasets fast.

twist.text: OLAP queries read a lot but write rarely. The opposite pattern of OLTP.

climax.text: Data warehouses are OLAP systems. They exist to answer the big questions, not process transactions.

punchline.text: OLTP records the facts. OLAP finds the meaning.
